initial_sender: Shared sender code and byte-identical notes for each trial/task.
stage_2: Sequential branches retain their own stage-1 outputs; no cross-condition repairs.
budget: Initial context at most 1200 characters; full retrieval allowed in both arms.
notebook: Markdown notes with local BM25 lookup; current steering and latest note excerpt in initial packet.
memory: Actual Agent Memory API, local FTS, no remote embeddings.
private_grader: Author pack; pre-frozen, no feedback to workers.
isolation: Instruction-scoped workspaces; no claimed OS read barrier.
model: Same inherited root model, no override. Exact native model usage unavailable.
run_order: Stage 1 memory trial1, notebook trial1, notebook trial2, memory trial2. Stage 2 reversed condition order.
